Name: Froststar11's Canine Collection (dog replacer)
Author: froststar11
Description:
[b]This mod is only available here at Nexus Mods! If you see it anywhere else, it has been uploaded without my permission and should be taken down immediately![/b]

Choose your dog breed from a huge list! A combination of breeds from some great sprite artists on Nexus, and my own additional recolors to give you a huge selection all in one place! Change your dog's breed every time you play, or pick your favorite and stick with it. No file replacement necessary! Content Patcher does the work.

[u]Install[/u]:

- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- Download and unzip the mod file
- Copy the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods 
- Choose your breed in the config file
- Load the game using SMAPI and enjoy!

[u]Sprites Credit:[/u]

The only sprite set I made was the Rottweiler, and even that used Mags' Black Lab as a template. Here's the designers of the other sprites:

Corgi: Kompi
Brindle Corgi: Zhuria
Fox Terrier: Zhuria
Australian Dog Pack: Stupiddullahans
Floppy HM dog: Raccoonleaf
Husky / Shiba Inu / Shepherd: Bouhm
Labs, Pibbles, Golden, Grim, and Red Setter: Mag's Dogs

Downloads.Description: Unzip into your mods folder. Open Config.json and choose your dog breed. Save. Open the game and enjoy!
